info.name: Oracle Cloud Bridge Ocb Agent Svc API
ocbAgentSvc
Gets a list of all AgentDependencies in a compartment.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: agentId
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given Agent ID.

params.name: environmentId
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given environment ID.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources their lifecycleState matches the given lifecycleState.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.

items.docs: Returns a list of AgentDependencies such as AgentDependencyCollection.
